The bare 'Vesuvius' is the volcano (B1 F4, B4 F19), never a sense of the entity's name; the archive's 'Vesuvius' in #1443 Part X is the entity by context (D1443-11). 'Scroll Prize' is the census's other name (RF-02) and 'scrollprize' the entity's domain and handle. The distinct entities below are named by the field or the census beside the entity and are never senses of its name.

captures.description: THE VESUVIUS CHALLENGE, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a global open science competition that uses artificial intelligence and 3D imaging to read carbonized ancient papyrus scrolls from the Villa of the Papyri in Herculaneum.' The scrolls, the technology (CT scanning, virtual unwrapping, ink detection), the milestones (founding in 2023, the first word 'purple', PHerc. 1667), the prizes, embedded videos. Eleven cards: the challenge's own site, Smithsonian, Kentucky, Wikipedia, X, Nebraska, UKNow, four videos. Supplied as an attached file, twice, the two copies byte-identical.
